verdict.rationale: Vapi documents an official MCP server that exposes Vapi APIs as tools over the Model Context Protocol. Any MCP-compatible assistant, such as Claude Desktop, or an agent framework can use it to manage assistants, phone numbers and calls, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, documented setup details (transport, authentication, full tool inventory).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Vapi MCP Server exposes Vapi APIs as tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), so you can manage assistants, phone numbers, and calls from any MCP-compatible AI assistant
